title: TikTok will pay $400 million to settle DOJ child privacy lawsuit
summary: The US Department of Justice announced on Friday that TikTok will pay $400 million to settle a lawsuit filed in 2024 over allegedly violating the Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA). In the lawsuit, the DOJ alleged that TikTok collected data from children without notifying parents or obtaining consent and did not delete the accounts […]
llm_summary: TikTok has agreed to pay $400 million to resolve a DOJ lawsuit accusing the platform of breaching the Children’s Online Privacy Protection Act. The government alleged TikTok collected personal data from users under 13 without parental consent and failed to delete those accounts when required. The settlement ends the case, though it does not admit wrongdoing, and underscores growing regulatory scrutiny of how social‑media apps handle minors’ data.
